# Resources

![](https://www.bizagi.com/files/live/sites/bizagi/files/Platform/integration-hero.png)

##### Xchange

Map processes, add functions and connect to external systems and applications using our free templates, widgets and connectors.

[Visit](https://www.bizagi.com/en/platform/xchange)

##### User Guides

Find help guides for all products in the Bizagi suite to assist you with the modeling and automation of your business processes.

[Read](https://www.bizagi.com/en/resources/help)

##### Blog

Keep up to date with Bizagi company news and platform innovations as well as trends within the digital transformation industry.

[Read](https://www.bizagi.com/en/blog)

##### Learning Portal

Find details of Bizagi’s range of modeling, automation and development learning courses and certifications.

[Visit](http://elearning.bizagi.com/my/)

##### Webinars

Watch the latest digital transformation webinars from Bizagi.

[Watch](https://fast.wistia.com/embed/channel/jkx8tlqkco)

##### Content Center

Get insight into the digital process automation market and advice on implementation best practice.

[Visit](https://www.bizagi.com/en/resources/content-center)
